title: Update the install when the app says it is stale
done: That is it: Set-up Info opens, with the text to paste into a session.

steps.caption: After an update, the app compares what Claude installed with what it now ships, and says when they differ.
Some features need the new files: the notice names the ones that are out of date.
Open Set-up Info, and paste its text into a session again. Claude replaces the old files.
Your turn: press Open Set-up Info.
